title: I think my kid goes to mall world
content: I recall having “bad dreams” my entire life, so much so, that I added an addendum to my nightly prayer as a child. As an adult, I am not nearly as frightened of them, but they can be extremely off putting. Bedtime is a challenge at my house because my daughter doesn’t want to go to sleep because she has bad dreams at night. I fear I may have brought her into this consciousness somehow. I feel badly because the dreams were so frightening as a child. Has anyone else had this experience?
